title: X-Fried Australian Fish Pilaf
description: A light and refreshing Australian-inspired dish featuring pan-seared fish, crunchy pilaf, and tangy basil notes.
instructions: Rinse the cod fillets under cold water, pat dry with paper towels.
Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large non-stick pan over medium-high heat.
Add the cod fillets, skin side up, and sear for 3-4 minutes.
Flip the cod, reduce heat to medium, and cook for an additional 5-6 minutes, or until cooked through.
While the cod cooks, heat 1 tablespoon of sesame oil in a separate pan over medium heat.
Add the jasmine rice and cook, stirring frequently, for 5-7 minutes, or until lightly toasted.
Add the furikake seasoning, salt, and black pepper to the rice and stir to combine.
Transfer the cooked rice to a serving platter or individual plates.
Top the rice with the cooked cod fillets and garnish with fresh parsley and basil leaves.
